{{recipe}}

'''Caprese salad''' is a delicious Italian dish made with [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] and [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella]] cheese. It is quite simple but tastes great and looks attractive.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomato]]
* A few [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] leaves
* about ¾ the weight of [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|Mozzarella cheese]] as the tomato, [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Vinegar|Balsamic vinegar]]
* [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]] or [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]] and [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]] (optional)

== Procedure ==

# Cut the tomato into about 5 slices. 
# Put a slice of mozzarella cheese on top of each tomato slice.
# Cut a horizontal slit halfway through each slice.
# Put a basil leaf on top of each one.
# Sprinkle herbs over each slice.
# Drizzle some vinegar and olive oil on top. Do not mix the vinegar and olive oil.
# Eat fresh.
